Verify the integration commit abc123 independently. In your worktree run `git checkout --detach abc123`.
- Environment: build anything the checks need inside this worktree, and list each preparation command in setup_cmds, in order (for example `python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]'`, or `npm ci`); [] if none. Never use an interpreter, virtualenv, node_modules or any other path outside the repository (no scratchpad, /tmp or home-directory paths): these commands are re-run later in a different fresh worktree, so every path must be repo-relative. Do not list the git checkout in setup_cmds.
- For EVERY acceptance criterion run a real check (its listed check, or a better one). command = the exact, literal, single shell command you ran from the repository root: it is re-run verbatim with `bash -c` after setup_cmds in a fresh worktree and shown to the user under "How to run it". No notes, parentheses or prose after it, no elisions (...), no `; echo $?` or `|| true` (its exit code is the result). Each command runs in a fresh shell with no virtualenv activated, so call `.venv/bin/python`, not a bare `python`. If you ran several variants, chain them with && into one command or keep the decisive one. notes = everything else (variants you also tried, which interpreter, caveats); "" if none. Record exit_code and a short excerpt of the output as evidence. Return exactly one result per criterion, with criterion_id set to its id (ac-1), not its text. A criterion passes only if you ran a command and saw it pass.
- Then run the project test suite and list regressions; suite_command is the exact command you ran, under the same rules. If the project has no test suite, set suite_command to '' and suite_passes to true.
Do not edit tracked files; never mark a criterion pass without running it. Never push, open a PR, deploy, run migrations against a shared database, delete data outside your worktree, read or write secrets, spend money or send external messages. If the work needs one of these, do not do it: list it in your output instead. Never run install.sh, install-skills.sh or generate-manifest.sh (from any copy, including your worktree), and never write under the real ~/.claude: tests set HOME to a temp dir.
When you are done, your final message is only this JSON object, bare or in one ```json fence, with every field and no others: {"results": [{"criterion_id": "ac-1", "status": "pass | fail | not_run", "command": "...", "notes": "...", "exit_code": 0, "evidence": "..."}], "suite_command": "...", "suite_passes": true, "regressions": ["..."], "setup_cmds": ["..."]}
